definition: the room where you prepare and cook food
exampleSentence: My parents are cooking in the kitchen.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ tôi đang nấu ăn trong bếp.

definition: a flat round dish that you eat food from
exampleSentence: The plates are on the table.
exampleTranslation: Những cái đĩa đang ở trên bàn.

definition: a round open container for food or liquid
exampleSentence: I eat a bowl of rice every day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn một bát cơm mỗi ngày.

definition: a small container with a handle for drinking tea or coffee
exampleSentence: Would you like a cup of tea?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn một tách trà không?

definition: a tall cup with a handle, used for hot drinks
translation: cốc có quai, ly có quai
exampleSentence: I drink coffee from a big mug.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống cà phê bằng một chiếc cốc lớn có quai.

definition: a container made of glass that you drink from
exampleSentence: Can I have a glass of water?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một ly nước được không?

definition: a small plate that you put a cup on
translation: đĩa lót tách, đĩa kê tách
exampleSentence: Put the cup on the saucer.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đặt tách lên đĩa lót.

definition: a flat container for cooking or serving food
exampleSentence: I put the dish on the table.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đặt đĩa thức ăn lên bàn.

definition: a flat piece of plastic or metal for carrying plates and food
exampleSentence: The waiter brought drinks on a tray.
exampleTranslation: Người phục vụ mang đồ uống ra trên một cái khay.

definition: cups, plates and dishes used for eating
exampleSentence: The crockery is in the cupboard.
exampleTranslation: Bát đĩa ở trong tủ bếp.

definition: knives, forks and spoons used for eating
translation: dao thìa nĩa, bộ dao dĩa
exampleSentence: Please put the cutlery on the table.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đặt dao thìa nĩa lên bàn.

definition: a tool with points that you use to pick up and eat food
exampleSentence: I eat noodles with a fork.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn mì bằng nĩa.

definition: a tool with a sharp blade for cutting food
exampleSentence: Use a sharp knife to cut the bread.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng dao sắc để cắt bánh mì.

definition: a tool with a small bowl-shaped end for eating or cooking
exampleSentence: Stir the soup with a spoon.
exampleTranslation: Hãy khuấy súp bằng thìa.

definition: a small spoon, also used to measure small amounts in cooking
translation: thìa cà phê, muỗng cà phê
exampleSentence: Add one teaspoon of sugar.
exampleTranslation: Thêm một thìa cà phê đường.

definition: a large spoon for serving food or measuring
exampleSentence: Add two tablespoons of flour.
exampleTranslation: Thêm hai thìa canh bột mì.

definition: a pair of thin sticks used for eating food, especially in Asia
exampleSentence: Do you know how to use chopsticks?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có biết dùng đũa không?

definition: a piece of cloth or paper for cleaning your hands and mouth at a meal
exampleSentence: Can I have a napkin, please?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi xin một cái khăn ăn được không?

definition: a cloth that covers a table
exampleSentence: We put a clean tablecloth on the table.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi trải một chiếc khăn sạch lên bàn.

definition: a container with a handle for pouring liquids
exampleSentence: Fill the jug with milk.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rót đầy sữa vào bình.

definition: a container with a handle for holding and pouring liquids
exampleSentence: There is a pitcher of water on the table.
exampleTranslation: Có một bình nước trên bàn.

definition: a container with a spout for making and serving tea
exampleSentence: Put hot water in the teapot.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đổ nước nóng vào ấm trà.

definition: a bottle that keeps drinks hot or cold
exampleSentence: I take a flask of tea to work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mang một bình trà giữ nhiệt đi làm.

definition: a box for carrying food to school or work
translation: hộp cơm, hộp đựng cơm trưa
exampleSentence: My lunchbox is in my bag.
exampleTranslation: Hộp cơm của tôi ở trong cặp.

definition: a big deep spoon with a long handle for serving soup
exampleSentence: Use a ladle to serve the soup.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng muôi để múc súp.

definition: a flat tool for turning, lifting or spreading food
exampleSentence: Turn the egg with a spatula.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lật trứng bằng xẻng lật.

definition: a kitchen tool for mixing air into eggs or cream
translation: cây đánh trứng, dụng cụ đánh trứng
exampleSentence: Use a whisk to mix the eggs.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng cây đánh trứng để trộn trứng.

definition: a tool with a rough surface for cutting food into small pieces
exampleSentence: I use a grater for cheese.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng cái nạo để bào phô mai.

definition: a tool for removing the skin of fruit and vegetables
exampleSentence: Use a peeler to peel the potatoes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng dụng cụ gọt vỏ để gọt khoai tây.

definition: a tool for opening tins of food
exampleSentence: Where is the tin opener?
exampleTranslation: Cái mở đồ hộp ở đâu?

definition: a tool for taking the lid off a bottle
translation: đồ mở chai, cái khui chai
exampleSentence: Do you have a bottle opener?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có đồ khui chai không?

definition: a tool for pulling the cork out of a bottle
translation: cái mở nút chai, đồ khui rượu vang
exampleSentence: I need a corkscrew to open the wine.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần một cái khui nút chai để mở rượu vang.

definition: a bowl with small holes for draining water from food
exampleSentence: Pour the pasta into a colander.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đổ mì ống vào rổ cho ráo nước.

definition: a kitchen tool with small holes for separating solids from liquids
exampleSentence: Use a strainer for the tea.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng cái lọc để lọc trà.

definition: a tool with a wire net for separating solid food from liquid
exampleSentence: Put the flour through a sieve.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rây bột mì qua cái rây.

definition: a board that you cut food on
exampleSentence: Cut the onion on a chopping board.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thái hành trên thớt.

definition: a tube-shaped tool for making dough flat
exampleSentence: Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng cây cán bột để cán phẳng bột.

definition: a flat metal tray for baking food in an oven
exampleSentence: Put the cookies on a baking tray.
exampleTranslation: Hãy xếp bánh quy lên khay nướng.

definition: a long thin stick for holding pieces of meat while cooking
exampleSentence: Put the meat on a skewer.
exampleTranslation: Hãy xiên thịt vào que.

definition: a tool with two arms for picking up food
exampleSentence: Use tongs to turn the meat.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng kẹp gắp để lật thịt.

definition: a round metal container for cooking, usually with a long handle
exampleSentence: Heat some oil in a pan.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đun nóng một ít dầu trong chảo.

definition: a flat pan with a long handle for frying food
exampleSentence: Cook the eggs in a frying pan.
exampleTranslation: Hãy chiên trứng trong chảo.

definition: a deep round metal pot with a handle for cooking
exampleSentence: Boil the water in a saucepan.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đun sôi nước trong nồi.

definition: a wide bowl-shaped pan used in Chinese cooking
exampleSentence: I cook vegetables in a wok.
exampleTranslation: Tôi xào rau trong chảo xào.

definition: a deep covered dish for cooking food in an oven
translation: nồi hầm, nồi nướng có nắp
exampleSentence: Put the casserole in the oven.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cho nồi hầm vào lò nướng.

definition: a container for cooking food in steam
exampleSentence: Cook the fish in a steamer.
exampleTranslation: Hãy hấp cá trong nồi hấp.

definition: a covered pot that cooks food quickly using steam
exampleSentence: A pressure cooker cooks beans very fast.
exampleTranslation: Nồi áp suất nấu đậu rất nhanh.

definition: a metal container for food or drink
exampleSentence: I opened a can of soup.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mở một hộp súp.

definition: a piece of kitchen equipment that you cook on
exampleSentence: The soup is on the stove.
exampleTranslation: Súp đang ở trên bếp.

definition: the flat top of a cooker with places to heat pans
exampleSentence: Put the pan on the hob.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đặt chảo lên mặt bếp.

definition: a machine for mixing food together
exampleSentence: I use a mixer to make cakes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng máy trộn để làm bánh.

definition: a large container in a kitchen for washing dishes
exampleSentence: The dirty plates are in the sink.
exampleTranslation: Những cái đĩa bẩn đang ở trong bồn rửa.

definition: a piece of equipment that controls water flowing from a pipe
exampleSentence: Turn off the tap, please.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn tắt vòi nước.

definition: a piece of furniture with doors for storing plates and food
exampleSentence: The cups are in the cupboard.
exampleTranslation: Những cái cốc ở trong tủ bếp.

definition: a flat board on a wall for putting things on
exampleSentence: The jar is on the top shelf.
exampleTranslation: Cái hũ ở trên kệ trên cùng.

definition: a box that you pull out of furniture to keep things in
exampleSentence: The knives are in the kitchen drawer.
exampleTranslation: Dao nằm trong ngăn kéo bếp.

definition: clothing worn over the front of your clothes to keep them clean when cooking
exampleSentence: I wear an apron when I cook.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc tạp dề khi nấu ăn.

definition: a cloth for washing dishes
translation: khăn rửa bát, giẻ rửa chén
exampleSentence: Wipe the table with a dishcloth.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lau bàn bằng khăn rửa bát.

definition: a small cloth for drying dishes
translation: khăn lau bát, khăn lau chén
exampleSentence: Dry the plates with a tea towel.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lau khô đĩa bằng khăn lau bát.

definition: thick paper for cleaning up liquid and food
exampleSentence: Wipe the table with some kitchen roll.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lau bàn bằng giấy lau bếp.

definition: very thin metal sheets used for wrapping food
exampleSentence: Wrap the fish in foil.
exampleTranslation: Hãy gói cá trong giấy bạc.

definition: thin clear plastic used to cover food
exampleSentence: Cover the bowl with clingfilm.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đậy tô bằng màng bọc thực phẩm.

definition: a machine for weighing things
exampleSentence: Weigh the flour on the kitchen scales.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cân bột mì bằng cân nhà bếp.

definition: an instrument that measures time when you are cooking
exampleSentence: Set the timer for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đặt hẹn giờ mười phút.

definition: a set of instructions for cooking a type of food
exampleSentence: Do you have a recipe for this cake?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có công thức làm bánh này không?

definition: one of the foods you use to make a dish
exampleSentence: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl.
exampleTranslation: Hãy trộn tất cả nguyên liệu trong một cái tô.

definition: to prepare food by heating it
exampleSentence: I cook dinner every evening.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nấu bữa tối mỗi tối.

definition: to cook food in very hot water
exampleSentence: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy luộc trứng trong mười phút.

definition: to cook food in hot oil
exampleSentence: I fry eggs for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chiên trứng cho bữa sáng.

definition: to cook food in an oven using dry heat
exampleSentence: I bake bread on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nướng bánh mì vào Chủ nhật.

definition: to cook meat or vegetables in an oven
exampleSentence: We roast a chicken on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi quay một con gà vào Chủ nhật.

definition: to cook food over or under strong direct heat
exampleSentence: Grill the fish for five minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nướng cá trong năm phút.

definition: to cook food using steam
exampleSentence: Steam the vegetables for five minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy hấp rau trong năm phút.

definition: to cook food gently in liquid just below boiling
exampleSentence: Let the soup simmer for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy để súp sôi nhỏ lửa trong mười phút.

definition: to cut food into small pieces
exampleSentence: Chop the onions into small pieces.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thái nhỏ hành.

definition: to cut food into thin flat pieces
exampleSentence: Slice the tomatoes thinly.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thái cà chua thành lát mỏng.

definition: to remove the skin of fruit or vegetables
exampleSentence: Peel the potatoes before you boil them.
exampleTranslation: Hãy gọt vỏ khoai tây trước khi luộc.

definition: to move food around with a spoon to mix it
exampleSentence: Stir the sauce so it does not burn.
exampleTranslation: Hãy khuấy nước sốt để nó không bị cháy.

definition: to combine two or more things into one
exampleSentence: Mix the eggs and flour in a bowl.
exampleTranslation: Hãy trộn trứng và bột mì trong tô.

definition: to make a liquid flow out of a container
exampleSentence: Pour the milk into the glass.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rót sữa vào ly.

definition: to wash plates, dishes and knives after a meal
exampleSentence: I wash up after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rửa bát sau bữa tối.
